name: VisaList Passport Index API
tagline: Visa-free access and passport ranking data for destination eligibility.
description: VisaList/Passport Index API provides visa-free access and passport ranking data for destination eligibility. It offers comprehensive data on passport rankings, visa-free countries, and destination eligibility for various passports. The API is designed for developers and travel applications to integrate accurate and up-to-date visa information.

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header, self-serve signup

rate_limits: 1,000 req/day free, paid plans have higher limits
use_cases: get current weather for a city
check visa requirements for a passport
list visa-free countries for a passport
